intro: Police work builds social perceptiveness, judgment and coordination, skills that matter in supervision, inspection and compliance. Of the 25 careers below, First-Line Supervisors of Police and Detectives match best at 84%, with a BLS May 2025 median of $106,040.
why_it_works: Officers read tense situations fast, make decisions that hold up later and work closely with dispatch, courts and other agencies. O*NET rates social perceptiveness at 4 out of 5 for patrol officers, which is why investigation, compliance and emergency roles rank high. Fire inspectors and compliance officers use the same eye for detail you bring to a report. Supervisor roles build on the field experience you already have. The main gaps are management skills, such as operations analysis and leading staff.
tips: Translate patrol work into civilian terms: incident reports become documentation, and de-escalation becomes conflict resolution.
Look at roles that value your background directly, such as compliance, fire inspection, security management or insurance investigation.
If you want to stay in public safety, ask about promotion paths or a lateral move to a specialized unit before you leave.

faq.q: What jobs can former police officers do?
faq.a: The closest matches are First-Line Supervisors of Police and Detectives (84%), First-Line Supervisors of Correctional Officers (80%) and Coroners (79%), based on O*NET 31.0 data. Outside law enforcement, Compliance Officers (75%) and Fire Inspectors and Investigators (74%) also use your judgment and reporting skills.

faq.q: Which careers for former police officers pay more?
faq.a: 9 of the 25 matches pay more than the $76,210 median for patrol officers in BLS May 2025 data. Air Traffic Controllers lead at $148,080, a 94% increase, though the FAA has strict hiring rules. Police supervisors earn $106,040 (+39%) and fire supervisors earn $93,530 (+23%).

faq.q: Do police officers need a degree to change careers?
faq.a: Mostly not. 20 of the 25 matches usually need no more education than a patrol officer has, based on O*NET Job Zones. The other 5 usually need a bachelor's degree, including Compliance Officers and Probation Officers and Correctional Treatment Specialists, so check the education column first.

faq.q: What jobs are similar to being a police officer?
faq.a: Within law enforcement, the nearest roles are Transit and Railroad Police (94% match), Detectives and Criminal Investigators (90%) and Customs and Border Protection Officers (87%). Bailiffs (85%) and Fish and Game Wardens (78%) are other options that keep you in public safety with a different daily routine.
